content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Gumroad and other platforms impose hefty fees—up to 10% on sales—that can cripple your earnings. With COREMERCH's infrastructure, you transition away from these constraints, utilizing NOWPayments which only charges a mere 0.5%. This difference means that on 100 sales of a $97 ebook, you retain an additional $921. Your store operates independently, meaning you're not at the mercy of platform outages or changing policies. This approach empowers you to take control of your digital sales environment.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before launching your ebook store, ensure you have your digital products ready for sale, whether they are formatted ebooks, templates, or multimedia content. You'll need a domain name for your store, a hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and a NOWPayments account for handling Bitcoin transactions. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers as these will serve as the backbone for your automated order processing and delivery system. By gathering these resources, you are setting the stage for a seamless deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring NOWPayments for automatic payment processing. This requires linking your cryptocurrency wallet to the NOWPayments platform. Once set up, integrate it with your store using either Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate payment verification and order fulfillment. Your ebook delivery can be managed through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring that once a payment is confirmed, the product is automatically delivered to the customer. This streamlined process guarantees efficiency and enhances customer satisfaction.
Gumroad's 10% fee pales in comparison to NOWPayments' 0.5%.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your infrastructure in place, it's time to go live. Begin by testing your payment and delivery systems with a small transaction to ensure everything functions correctly. Once confirmed, promote your store through social media or digital marketing channels to drive traffic. Monitor your sales and be prepared to address customer inquiries promptly. The moment your first transaction goes through, you’ll experience the freedom of running a fully independent digital storefront, untethered from traditional payment platforms.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing initial sales, consider scaling your operations. Analyze customer feedback to optimize your product offerings and improve your website's user experience. You may add more products or diversify your digital portfolio with templates, courses, or plugins. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all necessary blueprints and templates to further enhance your store. As your sales increase, ensure that your delivery systems can handle higher volumes without compromising performance.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Retain more earnings with complete control over your digital sales.

This guide aligns with the interest in establishing a digital download store that operates exclusively on cryptocurrencies, bypassing platform limitations. For comprehensive resources, consider investing in the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, which offers the complete blueprint for building your sovereign commerce stack.
Your Deployment Checklist

Gather your digital products and prepare them for sale. Choose a domain name for your store. Set up hosting via GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Create a NOWPayments account for crypto transactions. Utilize Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for automation. Configure file delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test your payment pipeline with a small transaction. Launch your store and promote it to your audience.
